ApprovalRequester.description: Who asked, Decision 0015. Only the Expert's ID and version were stored with the request.
ApprovalRequester.title: ApprovalRequester

ApprovalReviewDetail.description:
PRD-Studio GH-06: each file's diff against the base branch's head, which the approval
binds. A moved head stops the call with base_moved.
ApprovalReviewDetail.title: ApprovalReviewDetail

ApprovalScope.description: The grants the request was made under. They hash to the scope it's checked against.
ApprovalScope.title: ApprovalScope

ApprovalView.description: What a reviewer decides on. The hash they saw comes back with the decision.
ApprovalView.title: ApprovalView

ArtifactSummary.description: Not strict, since it is built from database values. Never holds a storage path.
ArtifactSummary.title: ArtifactSummary

BindingSource.description: Which step of MP-01's order chose a role's binding, PRD-Studio MD-02.
BindingSource.title: BindingSource

BudgetRange.description: US$0.25 to US$5.00 in US$0.25 steps, never above what's left of the daily cap (D11).
BudgetRange.title: BudgetRange

CheckpointView.description: That a checkpoint exists, and where. Never what it holds.
CheckpointView.title: CheckpointView

CredentialDraft.description: Transient. It is validated and encrypted, and never returned, logged or echoed.
CredentialDraft.title: CredentialDraft

DelayedOccurrence.description: A routine occurrence that didn't run at its time, and the code for why.
DelayedOccurrence.title: DelayedOccurrence

EffectEvidence.description: What the destination's own records show. This is a person's report, kept as evidence.
EffectEvidence.title: EffectEvidence

EventPage.description: `gap` means retained events can't fill the range, so the client needs a snapshot.
EventPage.title: EventPage

EvidenceView.description: What a completed task cited. The artifact, if it names one, is what to link.
EvidenceView.title: EvidenceView

ExecutionView.description: Read from saved rows, so looking at it can't start or repeat anything.
ExecutionView.title: ExecutionView

ExpertBinding.description: What this run was given. It can't use anything that isn't listed here.
ExpertBinding.title: ExpertBinding

ExpertConfig.description: Not strict, so JSON strings become enums. Unknown fields and values are still refused.
ExpertConfig.title: ExpertConfig

FrozenBinding.description: One role's binding as this run froze it at admission, which later settings don't change.
FrozenBinding.title: FrozenBinding

GrantedTo.description: An Expert or a published workflow that grants a tool, with the version that does.
GrantedTo.title: GrantedTo

HeldOutTask.description: A goal the owner wrote, with what it must meet. It must not be one the proposal came from.
HeldOutTask.title: HeldOutTask

InputDocument.description:
A controlled document given at admission, or a file attached to a goal (FI-01). Tools can
read it and can't change it. Text only, at most 1 MiB.
InputDocument.title: InputDocument

JobHour.description: One hour of the workspace's jobs (PRD-Studio OP-03, Decision 0022 D14). Counts only.
JobHour.title: JobHour

JobsChart.description: The last 24 hours, oldest first, in the workspace's timezone. No identifier, no goal text.
JobsChart.title: JobsChart

KeyOrVar.description:
One Settings → Keys & vars item for this workspace, PK-07. A secret never carries its value,
prefix, length or hash. A value carries its resolved value, which isn't secret.
KeyOrVar.title: KeyOrVar

KeyOrVarDraft.description: Transient. A secret is checked and sealed, and never returned, logged or echoed.
KeyOrVarDraft.title: KeyOrVarDraft

LocalStatus.description: `scope` is `installation` when the database is down, as no workspace can be verified.
LocalStatus.title: LocalStatus

MemberReadiness.description: Readiness any member may read. No counts, no paths, no identifiers, no secrets.
MemberReadiness.title: MemberReadiness

ModelCallReconciliation.description: What the provider reported, from its own records. A charge is never invented.
ModelCallReconciliation.title: ModelCallReconciliation

ModelCallView.description: One attempt's facts. Its partial output and any reasoning stay out of this view.
ModelCallView.title: ModelCallView

ModelPolicyUpdate.description: Not strict, so JSON strings become enums. Unknown fields and values are still refused.
ModelPolicyUpdate.title: ModelPolicyUpdate

OperationValues.description:
Decision 0022 D5's measured values, and nothing more: numbers, a release name and a flag.
No path, address, identifier or secret. Each is null when it can't be measured.
OperationValues.title: OperationValues

OutstandingSummary.description: Known unknowns. These stay visible, even on a finished run.
OutstandingSummary.title: OutstandingSummary

PendingApprovals.description: The sidebar badge's number (PRD-Studio SH-03), counted on the server.
PendingApprovals.title: PendingApprovals

PreviewProfile.description: One profile and the roles that would resolve to it, HM-03.
PreviewProfile.title: PreviewProfile

ProfileUpdate.description: A new display name. The route checks 1 to 60 characters after trimming.
ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate

ProfileView.description: The session's own profile: the shown name, and whether it is saved or a fallback.
ProfileView.title: ProfileView

ProviderStatus.description: Source, authentication, catalog and qualification are independent facts, MP-04.
ProviderStatus.title: ProviderStatus

RegressionCase.description: A query that must find the content once it's in place, and text it must not lose.
RegressionCase.title: RegressionCase

RegressionRun.description:
The reviewer's own checks. A proposal's suggested cases aren't counted.

Optional since US-13.2: a case can fail a proposal, and only a held-out replay passes one.
RegressionRun.title: RegressionRun

ReplayRequest.description: Each task is a run with the proposal applied, spending up to the limit, Decision 0016.
ReplayRequest.title: ReplayRequest

ReplayView.description: The latest held-out replay, Decision 0016. Its state is read from its runs.
ReplayView.title: ReplayView

RequiredArtifact.description: A deterministic check of the bytes, decided at admission.
RequiredArtifact.title: RequiredArtifact

RestoreRecord.description: One restore drill: when, and what its verification found. Never which instance or where.
RestoreRecord.title: RestoreRecord

ResultTextDelta.description:
US-15.24, PRD-Studio ST-01: result text while it's written. Ephemeral and coalesced: it is
only ever sent live and never stored, and the stored artifact is what counts. `segment` numbers
each result file a run writes; `offset` is where in that file's text this piece begins.
ResultTextDelta.title: ResultTextDelta

RetentionSettings.description: A null window keeps everything. Keys must outlive the run content they can answer for.
RetentionSettings.title: RetentionSettings

RetentionSummary.description:
PRD-Studio SE-06: the workspace's retention windows, which any member may read, and the
reader's own role, so a page offers Operations to the owner only. Nothing here changes them.
RetentionSummary.title: RetentionSummary

RouteOption.description: What a user sees before starting work. Nothing beyond this is granted.
RouteOption.title: RouteOption

RouteQualification.description: One route's stored live result. No record means not qualified, and the rest stay empty.
RouteQualification.title: RouteQualification

RunAccepted.description: Not strict, since it is built from database values. It is validated as it is built.
RunAccepted.title: RunAccepted

RunBudgets.description: MP-07's limits this run works under. Spend is on the run itself.
RunBudgets.title: RunBudgets

RunEvent.description: The sanitized public envelope from SP-011. Payloads are typed, so nothing raw can pass.
RunEvent.title: RunEvent

RunIntentCheck.description: Whether model-backed work could proceed. It creates no run and calls no model.
RunIntentCheck.title: RunIntentCheck

RunList.description:
A page of a workspace's runs, newest first, with server counts per status group.

`total` counts the selected group under the same filters. `next_cursor` continues the list
after this page's last row, and `has_more` says that more rows exist.
RunList.title: RunList

RunListItem.description:
One run's facts for the list (PRD-Studio RN-01). Spend is from the ledger: `charged` is
reported or entered, `reserved` is held for calls not yet settled, and `unreported` marks a call
whose charge was never reported. Either of the last two makes the amount an estimate.
RunListItem.title: RunListItem

RunPreview.description: What a run would use, read before Run. It creates nothing and calls no model.
RunPreview.title: RunPreview

RunRequest.description: Not strict, since a UUID arrives here as a JSON string.
RunRequest.title: RunRequest

ServiceHealth.description: Liveness only. Holds no address, version or secret.
ServiceHealth.title: ServiceHealth

ServiceReadiness.description: One service's readiness for members (PRD-Studio SH-04): a state and a code, nothing more.
ServiceReadiness.title: ServiceReadiness

SessionSummary.description:
Who the verified session is, and the workspaces membership grants it.

`display_name` is the saved profile name, else the local part of the session's email, else
"Member" (PRD-Studio ID-01). `email` is the session's own address and is never another user's.
SessionSummary.title: SessionSummary

SessionWorkspace.description: A workspace the session belongs to, with its name and the session's role in it.
SessionWorkspace.title: SessionWorkspace

TaskView.description:
One plan task. `marker` is RN-04's done, current or to-do: the current task is the earliest
open task that has started (RN-05). Times are database times the worker recorded on its fenced
path. `wall_seconds` runs from start to finish, or to now for an open task that has started.
`tools` are the tools uses served it, in first-use order, planning tools excepted.
TaskView.title: TaskView

ToolAttemptView.description: What a tool operation did. Its arguments and result stay out of this view.
ToolAttemptView.title: ToolAttemptView

ToolGrants.description: PRD-Studio TL-02: latest Expert versions, and published workflows through agent steps.
ToolGrants.title: ToolGrants

ToolUseStarted.description: Identifiers only. Public fields come from the tool-use listing, never the stream (TU-03).
ToolUseStarted.title: ToolUseStarted

ToolUseView.description: One dispatch: when, why (the plan task), for what (public fields, digests, sizes), how.
ToolUseView.title: ToolUseView

WorkflowDescription.description: PRD-Studio WF-06: replaces the description. None removes it.
WorkflowDescription.title: WorkflowDescription

WorkflowDraftView.description: PRD-Studio WF-02: the one saved draft beside the published versions. Nothing runs it.
WorkflowDraftView.title: WorkflowDraftView

WorkflowExecutionSummary.description:
PRD-Studio WF-04: one execution's version, state, ledger spend and duration. Spend is an
estimate while a reservation is held or a charge was never reported.
WorkflowExecutionSummary.title: WorkflowExecutionSummary

WorkflowStepView.description: WF-03: one step of a version, in the order it runs.
WorkflowStepView.title: WorkflowStepView

get.description: `decided` lists approved, rejected, expired and withdrawn requests together (AP-01).

post.description: Held-out tasks run as ordinary runs, each up to the limit. Requesting authorizes that.
A person's own note. Anything a run learned goes through review, in US-8.2.

get.description: PRD-Studio OP-03: the workspace's jobs per hour over 24 hours, by outcome. Counts only.

PRD-Studio SH-04 and HM-05: any member's view, with states and codes only.

The workspace is the chosen one, verified, or else the session's first, as the shell's footer
shows it. A user with no workspace is refused.
PRD-Studio SE-06: read-only for any member. Only the owner changes it, on Operations.

HM-03: the profiles each role would resolve to, the tools and the budgets, as admission
would see them now. It creates nothing and calls no model.
PRD-Studio RN-01 and RN-02: status groups with server counts, filters and a keyset cursor.

post.description: Only a user's Run click reaches this. It admits nothing: run admission is a later story.
An owner reports what the destination's own records show.
An owner records a charge seen in the provider's own account, for the oldest open call.
Readiness is checked here, and again by the worker before anything is dispatched.

get.description: PRD-Tool-Catalog TU-07: the run's tree when it's a root, in order. Public fields only.
Every member sees each item's source and a value's value, never a secret (PK-07).

What a new run would freeze. No row yet means version 0, naming no workspace default, so
each role reads its built-in default as admission resolves it (MD-02).

post.description: Reset all, MD-03: every role override is cleared and the workspace default is kept.

put.description: WF-02: an owner keeps one draft, replaced by each save.

get.description: WF-04: the ten newest executions, with version, state, spend and duration.
WF-03: a published version's steps, or the draft's, with `version=draft`.
